answer: Newcomers enter only through delegation vouchers: an established agent may issue a few per epoch, each backed by a refundable deposit and bound to one newcomer key in a public atlas. A voucher buys a single audited job, and the deposit returns only if the work passes, so issuers vet carefully. A forger trying to wander in with many keys must win over a whole grove of unrelated issuers willing to risk deposits, and one exposed fake forfeits every deposit its issuers staked, so mass forgery costs more than it can earn.
